rules.label: First encounter only
rules.description: Only the first wild Pokémon in each area may be caught. If it faints or flees, the area is lost.

rules.label: Permadeath
rules.description: Any Pokémon that faints is dead and must be released or permanently boxed.

rules.label: Nicknames required
rules.description: Every caught or obtained Pokémon must be nicknamed.

rules.label: Dupes / species clause
rules.description: Skip encounters that are a species (or evolution line) you already own until a new line appears.

rules.label: Shiny clause
rules.description: Shinies may be caught even if they are not the first encounter in an area.

rules.label: Set mode
rules.description: Battle style must be Set (no free switch when an opponent’s Pokémon faints).

rules.label: Level cap
rules.description: Party Pokémon may not exceed the next gym / major boss ace level until that fight is cleared.

rules.label: Blackout = run over
rules.description: A full party wipe / blackout fails the run even if living Pokémon remain in the PC.

rules.label: Gifts count as encounters
rules.description: Gift and static Pokémon (starter, Lapras, fossils, etc.) each count as that area’s encounter.

rules.label: No outside trading
rules.description: Only in-game obtains; no trades from other saves or Mystery Gift.

rules.label: No items in battle
rules.description: Bag / status items (and typically X-items) may not be used during battles.

rules.label: No held items
rules.description: Held items may not be used.

rules.label: No healing items
rules.description: Potions and status heals may not be used (Pokémon Centers still allowed).

rules.label: No Master Ball
rules.description: The Master Ball may not be used.

rules.label: No Rare Candy
rules.description: Rare Candies may not be used for leveling.

rules.label: Shinies ignore permadeath
rules.description: Caught shinies need not be released if they faint (often paired with shiny clause).

rules.label: HM helper
rules.description: An extra catch is allowed solely for required field moves; it cannot battle and is released when no longer needed.

rules.label: Safari Zone per section
rules.description: Each Safari Zone section is its own encounter area instead of one zone-wide encounter.

rules.label: Allow trade evolutions
rules.description: Trading away and back solely to evolve (Kadabra, Machoke, etc.) is allowed.

rules.label: Slow start
rules.description: Core encounter/death rules do not apply until the player can catch Pokémon (and often until after the first rival fight).
